d:
From mass graves and mysterious skulls to ancient battlefields and forgotten tombs, some archaeological discoveries raise more questions than answers. Using advanced forensic technology, experts investigate bizarre finds from different corners of the world, uncovering stories of ancient violence, mysterious rituals and forgotten civilisations. What secrets will these discoveries reveal?
Watch Ancient Unexplained Files, S1, Episodes 10, 5, 2, 8, 6 & 4 on Discovery Channel India.
